annotations.title: Publish an earlier build of a site

description: Publish the build of an earlier deploy that went live, as a new deploy, in place of what the site shows now. A later push to the default branch replaces it. Pass the same idempotencyKey on a retry to publish it once. Requires the config:write capability.

deployId.description: A deploy id from list_site_deploys whose status is 'live'

idempotencyKey.description: Any unique string; repeat it on a retry

name: rollback_site
title: Publish an earlier build of a site
